title: Plausible Future, Wrong Choice: Steering World-Action Models toward Intended Future
abstract: arXiv:2610.28431v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: World-Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for embodied generalist policies by jointly modeling future world evolution and robot actions across diverse manipulation tasks. However, representing diverse futures is only the first step: a capable WAM must also generate futures that match the requirements of the current task and execution progress. In long-horizon manipulation where similar observation-action segments occur across different tasks and stages, existing approaches may generate locally plausible yet misdirected rollouts to drift toward wrong task stage, i.e., a phenomenon we term Stage Confusion. To address this problem, we propose TaskWAM, a closed-loop, stage-aware framework that represents fine-grained task requirements with Mode Tokens and tracks execution progress with State Tokens, forming a structured task state to steer world--action generation toward intended future. translated_title: 合理的未来，错误的选择：引导世界-动作模型趋向预期未来
translated_abstract: 世界-动作模型（WAM）通过在多样化操作任务中联合建模未来世界演化与机器人动作，已成为具身通用策略的一个有前景的范式。然而，表征多样化的未来仅仅是第一步：一个有能力的WAM还必须生成与当前任务需求和执行进度相匹配的未来。在长时程操作任务中，相似的观测-动作片段会出现在不同任务和阶段中，现有方法可能生成局部合理但方向错误的推演，从而漂移到错误的任务阶段，我们将这一现象称为“阶段混淆”。为解决这一问题，我们提出了TaskWAM，一个闭环的、阶段感知的框架，它使用模式Token表示细粒度的任务需求，使用状态Token追踪执行进度，形成结构化的任务状态，以引导世界-动作生成趋向预期的未来。我们进一步引入了StageBench（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 针对世界-动作模型在长时程操作中因相似片段而产生的“阶段混淆”问题，提出TaskWAM闭环框架，通过模式Token与状态Token构建结构化任务状态，引导模型生成符合任务需求与执行进度的预期未来。
